name: Necromancer
fantasy: A lich-priest in grave-rune robes behind a skull mask, a lantern of trapped souls at his belt. He fights from behind the dead: bolts of bone, and graveyards torn up from the ground whose risen dead claw at all within.

directions.name: Grave
directions.desc: The graveyard and its risen dead: bigger, longer, more of them.

directions.name: Bone
directions.desc: Bolts of bone: harder, faster, cheaper.

directions.name: Soul
directions.desc: What the dead give back: mana and quicker graves.

skills.name: Bone Bolt
skills.desc: Hurl a shard of bone for 110% weapon damage. It pierces the first foe.

skills.name: Graveyard
skills.desc: Tear a graveyard up from the ground at the cursor for 8 s. Its 4 risen dead strike a foe inside it every second for 45% weapon damage each, and its chill slows foes 25%.

rites.name: Restless Horde
rites.text: Graveyard's risen dead strike for {dmg:graveyard}% more.
